title: Puthoff skeptical of Lazar after a clearance check

tellings.quote: to the degree behind the scenes we can check on his clearances and so on i have reason to be skeptical

plain: Hal Puthoff, a physicist who led government-funded research on unusual phenomena, says that checks made behind the scenes on Bob Lazar's security clearances give him reason to be skeptical. Lazar is a man who has claimed he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada. Puthoff says it in a debate on the show, and it matters because it would cast doubt on Lazar's claimed government work.
